title: Myths and Facts of Radiation Therapy | Dr. Kanika Sharma Sood (Hindi)
description: Radiation therapy also called radiotherapy is a cancer treatment that uses high doses of radiation to kill cancer cells and shrink tumors. At low doses, radiation is used in x-rays to see inside your body. The term "radiation therapy" most often refers to external beam radiation therapy.  Dr. Kanika Sharma Sood, Clinical Lead & Senior Consultant Oncology, Radiation Oncology at Dharamshila Narayana Superspeciality Hospital, Delhi, shared details on the myths and facts of Radiation Therapy as being aware of the side-effects is very important for the patients.  #NarayanaHealth #HealthForAll #AllForHealth #NHCares  Visit our website https://www.narayanahealth.org to know more about Narayana Health and its facilities. asr.full_text: Hello, my name is Dr. Kanika Sharma Sood. I am the Head of Radiation On am a specialist of Dharamshila Narayanan supervisaity hospital. Cancer and various other cancers are prevalent around you. So, today we want to know about some of the myths and illusions that many people have been rumored. First of all one of these myths is that radiation does not eliminate cancer from its roots and is not curative. This is not the case. Many of the diseases are such as the cancer of the vocal chords in the respiratory tract or the cancer of the mouth of the babies or lymphoma where radiation can kill cancer from its roots and lead to cancer liberation. In some situations, radiation can control to suppress the return of cancer some patients are given radiation for the reason that cancer do not return in this situation we call it adjuvant radiation in some cases where the disease has spread or is in its last stage where Radiation doesn't go away from its root but still pressures the body. For example if someone is having a bleeding or pain or some pressure on the nerves then radiation could be used to completely suppress that pain. In such a situation, radiation cannot go from the roots and chem such a situation, the problem doesn't go from both radiation or the blood. That problem is caused by the disease. The second myth that is common among people is that If you have much radiation, your skin will dry up. This myth or myth might be that people have read the case for the treatment that happened10, 15 or 20 years ago. But our technology was very cruel at that times we treated the skin While our technology was very crude back then our techniques were not advanced But now, we protect the skin and we give the radiation like the dose so that there are no late effects in the skin But often times tumours or cancer have reached the skin there are some skin cancers in those cases we have to give radiation to the skin In those cases, the mold will disappear over time And then the new mold will come Many people consider that with the coming of radiation all of the hair will fall Especially, many women ask me The cancer of baby roots Will there be the hair on the head will fall off. Many women come to ask me if the child has cancer of child bone will my hair all went. It is not like that It will happen only when the head is doing and all the brain tumors are there it is possible to fall hair on the head. If it is due to chemoaloprosy radiation does not fall Some people also ask that Doctor, will the radiation come out after the radiation? I can meet my children if there is a pregnant woman at home Can I live with other people? The fear about radiation must have started from Petsit when Petsit happens some cells come out of the body in 3 to 4 hours But nothing like in radiation If I ask the reason that my doctor has prescribed it? There is a theory that it has been prescribed by the doctor before. No doctor knows the answer but doctor has only explained the reason in the first place. So this is the only way that it is going to be done but it should be followed, to avoid the disease, it needs to go from the hospital. If there's any one doctor who will give her the dosage then it should be done by taking care of the patients and not doing anything. damage the DNA of damaged cells in a bad manner so a radiation patient can live with anybody and treat in any way they want and they share dishes so they use radiation some people think when radiation is there we only get cancer specially those people who listen to the stories of Nagasaki and Hiroshima This myth has a certain reality... but not complete Radiation is most likely a cancer to a few people Especially, those who have 20-30 years of experience after radiation treatment This may not be the highest level of accuracy But a cancer free person's life should be considered an achievement And it isn't a big intensity If a person leads a life on its own after being free from cancer that is another achievement Secondly, today we've some techniques, such as VMAT which we call volumetric arc therapy In that patient has to stay in his radiation room for only 6-7 minutes Due to that the overall radiation exposure of the body reduce so much that the risk of secondary cancers. Secondary cancers can also happen through chemotherapy such as chemotherapy. So this is why radiation is not responsible for any of the cases. Third, when people have hair loss they have an issue with the radiation which , it would not work like that , we use a tattoo or a needle to make a mark like this It might look like we want to rub or rub our hands with a strong and soft feeling Here , we use a radiation mark and is finished, it can be wash and cleaned automatically then some people feel that radiation will only damage all body and will destroy even the normal cells in the body it is not like radiation will destroy all especially when we are providing good equipment such as IMRT, IGRT or SPRT the effect of such equipment is taken into account to prevent radiation to reach outside the 1-2 mm radius of the tumors. That way, the effect is very less and the result of it is very minimal. and there is no negative effect. Now a myth is that the technique is very painful. This is not true that the technique is very painful. During the application of radiation we get no pain. The radiation is received like of CT scan, MRI or other And that is when the density of radiation can be reduced. If we try to consider our treatment as complete, and the right diagnosis and technique are chosen, then they can help restore quality of life.
